tools.name: calculate_worksheet_grid_geometry
tools.description: Calculate exact physical millimeter and PostScript point dimensions for printable Chinese writing grids (Tian Zi Ge, Mi Zi Ge, Jiu Gong Ge, Hui Zi Ge) on A4 or US Letter paper.

tools.name: lookup_chinese_stroke_order_rules
tools.description: Retrieve official Chinese Ministry of Education stroke ordering rules (horizontal before vertical, top-to-bottom, outside before closing) and the 8 fundamental calligraphy stroke primitives.

tools.name: analyze_hsk_vocabulary_level
tools.description: Classify Chinese characters or vocabulary sentences into official HSK proficiency tiers (HSK 1 to HSK 7-9), CEFR language equivalents (A1 to C2), and recommend matching printable worksheets.

tools.name: convert_pinyin_tone_format
tools.description: Convert between Mandarin Pinyin tone diacritics (ma1 -> mā) and numeric tones, decompose syllables into Initial, Final, Tone, and apply standard vowel tone placement hierarchy (a > o > e > i/u > ü).

tools.name: lookup_kangxi_radical_info
tools.description: Look up core Kangxi Chinese character radicals (e.g. 氵, 木, 火, 讠, 心, 扌, 女, 口) with semantic meaning, stroke count, typical structural placement, and high-frequency character examples.

tools.name: recommend_chinese_practice_pack
tools.description: Generate a structured Chinese character handwriting curriculum plan and direct printable sheet links tailored by learner age group, proficiency target, and grid preference.
